text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps behaviour identical (the `continue` paths become an equivalent if/else-if/else, and the site order and the `partial`/`gatingAny` early-return are preserved), every new method is well under 15, and I see no build-breaking accessibility or nullability problems. I haven't built it, so a style-analyzer member-ordering rule (e.g. StyleCop's public-before-private) is the one thing that could still trip warnings-as-errors.
